summary: Added sdk/reports/fleet.py: Throughput, AccountFleetRow, FleetReport and compute_fleet_report (own events only per account; rates None without attempts; elapsed and actions per hour; status and mode from FleetRun; incidents from AuditReport; time saved = manual minus operator minutes only when both supplied, fleet total None when none) with JSON and Markdown output. 5 tests in tests/test_fleet_report.py. Documented in docs/baseline/fleet-report.md.

contract_status_changes.before: No fleet-wide throughput, failure, isolation or time-saved metric
contract_status_changes.after: A fleet report gives per-account and fleet metrics with explicit mode, incidents and operator-supplied time saved

residual_risks: Time saved depends entirely on operator-supplied minutes; nothing measures them automatically.
